Craft Land Sandbox Block World – Build your own block world!

Welcome to Craft Land Sandbox Block World, an open-world sandbox game where creativity has no limits. Dive into a block-style universe and design your own city, house, castle, or entire world using simple tools and endless imagination.

Explore a massive voxel world, collect resources, craft items, and turn empty land into a vibrant crazy city built your way!

🔹 Main Features

🧱 Free Block Building
Build houses, skyscrapers, bridges, farms, and entire cities using hundreds of blocks and materials.

🌎 Open World Sandbox
Explore forests, mountains, rivers, and wide lands in a fully open 3D block world.

⛏️ Mine & Craft System
Gather wood, stone, and minerals to craft blocks, tools, and decorative items.

🎮 Easy & Smooth Controls
Enjoy simple gameplay designed for all ages with smooth performance on mobile devices.

🎨 Creative Customization
Change terrain, decorate buildings, and customize your city with unique designs.

⚔️ Survival & Creative Modes
Play Survival Mode to collect resources or Creative Mode with unlimited blocks and freedom.

top_apps.name: AveStore Supermarket Simulator
top_apps.description_short: Build and manage your own Pet Friendly supermarket
top_apps.description_excerpt:
AveStore: Supermarket Simulator - build the store of your dreams!

Create and develop your own supermarket with a unique feature - a Pet Friendly store where customers can shop together with their pets.

Start with a small shop and turn it into a large and profitable supermarket. Control every process: staff, deliveries, product placement, and business growth.

🐾 Pet Friendly - your advantage!

In AveStore, customers can visit your store with their pets - dogs and cats.

Maintain order, keep the store clean, and create a comfortable environment for both people and their four-legged companions. This increases your store's attractiveness and brings in more customers.

Develop and customize your store:
- Expand the sales area
- Add new departments
- Place shelves and display racks
- Optimize layout to increase profits
- Customize the store appearance

Smart space organization directly impacts your sales.

Manage your staff:
- Build an efficient team
- Cashiers serve customers and reduce queues
- Stockroom workers receive deliveries and sort goods in the warehouse
- Stockers refill shelves in the sales area
